import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2
    K = np.exp(p[7] + p[8]*t)
    n = p[9]
    S = np.abs(A)**n/(K + np.abs(A)**n)
    return base + amp*S
